messages:
Maya Rodrigues: Quick heads up — QBR prep: APAC SI tier recs + MDF reallocation needed. CloudRange partner asked to swap $60k MDF for HW credits tied to SI milestones. Need final decision by next Wed. Who can own reconciliation and the scorecard update? Links below.
Tom Wu: I can own reconciliation. I'll slot time Mon. @Rohit Singh can you pull the scorecard numbers? :raised_hands: 
Rohit Singh: Yep — I'll pull last 6mo engagement, attach revised tier points & impact to pipeline. Need partner-confirmed milestone list from HW vendor to model credit timing.
Elena García: On it — chasing HW vendor PO and credit terms now. Important note: vendor wants a 30-day QA sign-off before credits release. Also marketplace listing change may change our ARR weighting for this partner.
Tom Wu: Copying the spreadsheet I started here: https://tiny.redwood/qbr-apac-mdf (please make a personal copy and update tabs: reconciliation, scorecard, notes). Use the "Reconcile -> HW-credit-swap" tab for the $60k flow.
MarketplaceBot: Reminder: QBR docs template deadline in 3 days — upload final slides to the QBR folder. https://console.redwood/templates/qbr-checklist :bell:
Rohit Singh: Added draft numbers and comments on the milestones tab. I set two scenarios: conservative (credits post-QA) and aggressive (credits on deploy). Left inline notes where assumptions differ.
Tom Wu: Thanks Rohit — I'll reconcile cash vs credits under conservative first. If Elena confirms a shorter QA window we can flip to aggressive.
Elena García: Vendor replied: 30d QA but may shorten to 10d if SI provides automated test results. I'm asking SI to surface their test plan by EOD Fri.
Maya Rodrigues: Great — plan: Tom owns reconciliation, Rohit owns scorecard updates, Elena owns vendor/SI confirmation. I'll run a 15m sync Tue 10am PT to finalize numbers and doc zip. Add any blockers here and tag me. :white_check_mark:
